name: enb-postfx
description: The post-process pixel shader interface ENBSeries 0.163 expects. ENB names its entry point after the hash of the game shader it replaces and documents that shader's full parameter table in a comment block; this file is that table, transcribed. iCEnhancer 4.0's precompiled enbeffect.fx declares the same interface.
notes: motionBlurMatrix occupies c72..c75 (a row-major float4x4). ENB additionally declares sampler s13 for its own detail texture, which the game does not provide and which is therefore not part of what the game must supply.
